zh.headline: Anthropic 发布 Claude Tag，在 Slack 中嵌入持久化 AI 队友
zh.observation: 今天的简报被两个主题主导：**Agent 基础设施的全面爆发**和**AI 安全与对齐的深入博弈**。Anthropic 的 Claude Tag、Sakana 的 Fugu、xAI 的 /goal 以及 Cursor 的自研模型，共同指向一个趋势——AI Agent 正从单次对话转向持久化、自主化的"数字同事"。同时，OpenAI 的 Patch the Planet、Meta 的员工数据泄露事件、以及多篇关于 Agent 过早承诺和对抗性攻击的论文，表明安全不再是事后考虑，而是 Agent 规模化部署的核心瓶颈。值得特别关注的是，Google 将 Interactions API 设为 Gemini 默认接口，以及 Microsoft 开源 FastContext，都暗示了行业正在为 Agent 时代重构底层协议和工具链。

en.headline: Anthropic Launches Claude Tag, Embedding a Persistent AI Teammate in Slack
en.observation: Today's brief is dominated by two themes: **the explosion of agent infrastructure** and **the deepening game of AI safety and alignment**. Anthropic's Claude Tag, Sakana's Fugu, xAI's /goal, and Cursor's proprietary model all point to one trend—AI agents are evolving from single-turn conversations into persistent, autonomous "digital coworkers." Meanwhile, OpenAI's Patch the Planet, Meta's employee data leak, and multiple papers on premature commitment and adversarial attacks show that safety is no longer an afterthought but a core bottleneck for agent deployment at scale. Notably, Google making Interactions API the default for Gemini and Microsoft open-sourcing FastContext both signal that the industry is rebuilding underlying protocols and toolchains for the agent era.
